entry.title: OpenMath Content Dictionaries for Computer Algebra Systems
entry.summary: This paper studies the use of OpenMath content dictionaries to interoperate between computer algebra systems. We present a semantic layer that maps symbolic expressions to formal definitions and enables cross-system verification of algebraic identities.

entry.title: Four-Dimensional Logical Frameworks for Symbolic Computation
entry.summary: We propose a four-dimensional reasoning framework separating syntactic, semantic, structural and computational concerns when processing mathematical equations. The method improves reliability of automated theorem proving over polynomial equations.

entry.title: A Unified Scheduler for Mathematical Algorithm Alliances
entry.summary: We describe an authority-graded scheduler that coordinates parsing, solving and simplification algorithms under a single safe execution model. Permissions are logical, never operating-system level, ensuring reproducible and contained computation.
